'''Hutt security droids''' were [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] used by the ancient [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], at a time before the Hutts had many servant species. Millennia later, [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]]'s troops found a cache of the then-rare [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Varl, which Mika had restored to guard the [[Tempest (starship)|''Tempest'']]. The droids resembled Hutts, but were thinner, with two arms and thin heads atop segmented, [[Snake/Legends|snakelike]] bodies. Each droid had an improved [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package, [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensors]], sonic sensors, a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] built into one arm, and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] built into the other arm. The droids spoke [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] rather than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].

==Behind the scenes==
Since these droids are said to date back to a time when the Hutts had few servant species, they may be pre-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] models predating the [[Treaty of Vontor]].
